description: The entry point app.py calls, and the navigation builder split out from it so a test can assert the page set without executing Streamlit's actual page-render machinery.
docstring:
main: Process entry point.

Sequence:
    1. st.set_page_config(...).
    2. settings = config.load_settings().
    3. with storage.connect(settings.db_path) as conn: storage.initialize_schema(conn); storage.migrate(conn); orchestration.reconcile_orphaned_runs(conn) -- all inside one short-lived connection that closes before navigation runs, per ADR-017.
    4. nav = build_navigation(); nav.run() -- dispatches to whichever page function Streamlit selected, each of which opens its OWN short-lived connection (main's own connection from step 3 is already closed by the time a page function runs).

build_navigation: Returns st.navigation over three st.Page objects wrapping render_new_analysis_page ('Run New Analysis', url_path='new', default page), render_past_analyses_page ('Past Analyses', url_path='runs'), render_analysis_detail_page ('Analysis Detail', url_path='detail'). Built from plain functions, not the pages/ directory convention, per ADR-018 (that convention requires top-level scripts that cannot take arguments and cannot be imported into a test).
postconditions: reconcile_orphaned_runs runs exactly once per process start, before build_navigation, never inside a page render function
The connection opened in main's own startup sequence is closed before nav.run() dispatches to a page function
build_navigation's returned page set is exactly the three declared pages, with 'Run New Analysis' as the default

edge_cases.input: settings.db_path's parent directory does not exist yet (first-ever run of the app)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: storage.get_connection creates it; initialize_schema then creates all tables -- no manual setup step required before first launch

edge_cases.input: reconcile_orphaned_runs finds and reconciles orphaned runs on this startup
edge_cases.expected_behavior: main does not itself render anything about this; the Past Analyses page simply shows those runs as 'failed' with Resume available, the next time it is opened

edge_cases.input: main is called a second time in the same process (should not normally happen -- Streamlit calls it once per process, not once per rerun)
edge_cases.expected_behavior: reconcile_orphaned_runs running twice is harmless (idempotent per its own spec), just redundant

unit_tests.name: test_build_navigation_returns_three_pages_with_default
unit_tests.description: build_navigation's page set matches the three declared pages, 'Run New Analysis' marked default.
unit_tests.expected: 3 pages, correct titles and url_paths, correct default

unit_tests.name: test_main_calls_reconcile_before_navigation
unit_tests.description: Using stubs for storage and orchestration, main calls reconcile_orphaned_runs before build_navigation/nav.run(), asserted by call-order recording.
unit_tests.expected: reconcile_orphaned_runs precedes nav.run() in the call log

unit_tests.name: test_main_startup_connection_closed_before_dispatch
unit_tests.description: A connection-factory spy shows main's own connection is closed before any page-render function's connection is opened.
